# ServerBridge API Reference

> **Assembly:** `LocalExile.Client.ServerBridge` · **Public types:** `67`
>
> Gateway-side dual-mod host (`ClientBridgeHost`, `LocalExileGatewayHost`), Tier 1 `0.3.0`/`0.4.0` sessions (`IClientPhase1Session`, `IClientPhase2Session`), server-driven UI (`IClientUiSession`), atomic item transactions (`LocalExileGatewayTransactions`), custom Pet MTX & Currency registrars, and affix manipulation (`LocalExileItemAffixService`).

### `StoredAffixPayload`

**Kind:** `record` · **Namespace:** `LocalExile.Client.ServerBridge` · **Source:** `LocalExile.Client.ServerBridge/ItemAffixService.cs`

Persistent representation of an affix stored inside a Charged Currency item (such as Charged Orb of Siphoning). Maps 1:1 to a single `ItemMod` serialized in the currency item's `Mods` component and persisted in LocalExile's `characters.db` `item_mods` table.

```csharp
public sealed record StoredAffixPayload(string ModId, IReadOnlyList<int> RolledValues, string DisplayText, bool IsPrefix, string Group, ushort ModHash16 = 0, string DisplayName = "", bool IsSuffix = false, int Tier = 0, bool IsCrafted = false)
```

**Parameters / Properties:**

| Parameter | Description |
|---|---|
| `string ModId` | `Mods.dat` string identifier. |
| `IReadOnlyList<int> RolledValues` | Exact rolled stat values preserved across steal and imbue. |
| `string DisplayText` | Formatted PoE stat description text shown in UI and tooltips. |
| `bool IsPrefix` | `true` if Prefix. |
| `string Group` | Mod family/group exclusivity key. |
| `ushort ModHash16 = 0` | `Mods.dat` 16-bit wire hash. |
| `string DisplayName = ""` | Human-readable mod name (for example `Vigorous`). |
| `bool IsSuffix = false` | `true` if Suffix. |
| `int Tier = 0` | 1-based tier when known, or `0`. |
| `bool IsCrafted = false` | `true` if crafted (`Domain == 9`). |

**Properties:**

| Property | Summary |
|---|---|
| `public string SlotTag { get; }` | Short human-readable slot tag (`Prefix`, `Suffix`, or `Mod`). |

### `LocalExileItemAffixService`

**Kind:** `class` · **Namespace:** `LocalExile.Client.ServerBridge` · **Source:** `LocalExile.Client.ServerBridge/ItemAffixService.cs`

Reusable service for inspecting item affixes with formatted Path of Exile stat descriptions, validating and stealing a chosen affix, embedding that affix persistently on a Charged Currency item, and replacing a compatible affix on a second item while preserving exact rolled values. Supports both standalone `PortableItem` models and live LocalExile Gateway `Item` records.

```csharp
public sealed class LocalExileItemAffixService
```

**Constructors:**

| Constructor | Summary |
|---|---|
| `public LocalExileItemAffixService(object? defaultStatDescriptions = null, object? defaultItemRolls = null)` | Creates an affix service with optional default LocalExile `StatDescriptions` and `ItemRolls` tables used when formatting live Gateway item modifiers and resolving Rare/Unique `NameWords`. |

**Methods:**

| Method | Summary |
|---|---|
| `public static (int MaxPrefixes, int MaxSuffixes) GetAffixCaps(ItemRarityKind rarity, string itemClass)` | Computes the maximum allowed explicit prefixes and suffixes for an item's rarity and class. |
| `public static ItemAffixView Inspect(PortableItem item)` | Inspects a `PortableItem` and returns its explicit affixes with formatted stat descriptions. |
| `public static string? ValidateStealTarget(ItemAffixView view)` | Validates whether an item is eligible for affix siphoning (stealing an explicit modifier). |
| `public static (bool Allowed, string? Reason) CanReplaceAffix(ItemAffixView targetView, int replaceIndex, StoredAffixPayload storedAffix)` | Checks whether replacing the explicit affix at `replaceIndex` on `targetView` with `storedAffix` satisfies Prefix/Suffix caps, fracture protection, and mod-group exclusivity. |
| `public static AffixStealResult StealAffix(PortableItem source, int affixIndex, CustomCurrencyItemDefinition? chargedCurrencyDef = null, uint newChargedItemId = 0)` | Steals the explicit affix at `affixIndex` from `source` and optionally embeds it onto a new `PortableItem` representing `chargedCurrencyDef`. |
| `public static PortableItem CreateChargedCurrencyItem(CustomCurrencyItemDefinition chargedCurrencyDef, StoredAffixPayload storedAffix, uint itemId, uint inventoryId = 1)` | Creates a persistent `PortableItem` representing a Charged Currency item carrying `storedAffix` inside its `Enchant` mod list. |
| `public static StoredAffixPayload? ReadStoredAffix(PortableItem chargedCurrencyItem)` | Reads the `StoredAffixPayload` stored inside a Charged Currency `PortableItem`. |
| `public static AffixReplaceResult ReplaceAffix(PortableItem target, int replaceIndex, StoredAffixPayload storedAffix)` | Replaces the explicit affix at `replaceIndex` on `target` with `storedAffix`, preserving its exact rolled values and enforcing Prefix/Suffix and group rules. |
| `public static AffixReplaceResult ReplaceAffix(PortableItem target, int replaceIndex, StoredAffixPayload storedAffix, string? customName, bool clearCustomName = false)` | Replaces the explicit affix at `replaceIndex` on `target` with `storedAffix`, optionally setting or clearing `CustomName`. |
| `public ItemAffixView InspectGatewayItem(uint inventoryId, uint itemId, object gatewayItem, object itemCatalog, object? statDescriptions = null, object? itemRolls = null)` | Inspects a live LocalExile Gateway `GameServer.Core.Protocol.Instance.Item` using the live `ItemCatalog` (and optional `StatDescriptions` / `ItemRolls`) via reflection so `ServerBridge` stays decoupled from Gateway binaries while exposing exact live mod metadata, formatted PoE stat lines, and resolved Rare/Unique item names from `Words.dat`. |
| `public StoredAffixPayload? ReadStoredAffixFromGatewayItem(object gatewayCurrencyItem, object itemCatalog, object? statDescriptions = null)` | Reads a `StoredAffixPayload` stored on a live LocalExile Gateway Charged Currency `Item` (searching `ModSection.Enchant`, then `Implicit`, then `Explicit`). |
| `public static string FormatStatTemplate(string template, IReadOnlyList<int> values, IReadOnlyList<(string Name, int Stat)>? handlers = null)` | Formats a PoE stat description template string (from `stat_descriptions.txt`) with concrete rolled values and standard PoE stat handlers (`negate`, `divide_by_one_hundred`, `divide_by_ten`, `per_minute_to_per_second`, `milliseconds_to_seconds`, etc.). |
| `public static bool MatchesStatCondition(string condition, int value)` | Evaluates a PoE `stat_descriptions.txt` condition token (`#`, `1\|#`, `#\|-1`, `5`, `!0`). |
| `public static string? GetGatewayItemCustomName(object gatewayItem)` | Reads `Item.CustomName` from a live LocalExile Gateway `GameServer.Core.Protocol.Instance.Item` record, returning `null` if unset or empty. |
| `public static object WithGatewayItemCustomName(object gatewayItem, string? customName)` | Returns a cloned Gateway `Item` with `CustomName` set to `customName` (normalizing empty/whitespace strings to `null` so the `0x80` wire flag is cleared) while preserving `RequiredLevel`. |
| `public static (uint InventoryId, uint ItemId)? LocateCurrencyStack(object playerInventories, object? accountStash, uint typeHash, bool includePublicStashTabs = false)` | Locates a stack of `typeHash` in main inventory first, then non-public stash tabs. |
| `public static (uint InventoryId, uint ItemId)? LocateStack(object playerInventories, object? accountStash, uint typeHash, bool includePublicStashTabs = false)` | Alias for `LocateCurrencyStack`. |
| `public static GatewayItemLocation? LocateGatewayItem(object playerInventories, object? accountStash, uint inventoryId, uint itemId)` | Locates an item by `inventoryId` and `itemId` across inventories and stash. |
| `public static GatewayGrantResult GrantItems(object itemCatalog, object playerInventories, uint typeHash, ushort count = 1, string? customName = null, bool requireFullFit = false, Func<object, object?>? shapeOf = null)` | Grants `count` items into main inventory without sending packets. |
| `public static Task<GatewayGrantResult> GrantItemsAsync(object? player, object itemCatalog, object playerInventories, uint typeHash, ushort count = 1, string? customName = null, bool requireFullFit = false, Func<object, object?>? shapeOf = null, Func<object, byte[], string?, Task>? sendPacket = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)` | Grants `count` items into main inventory and sends grouped `0x00BF` diffs. |
| `public Task<GatewayStealResult> StealAffixOnGatewayItem(object? player, object itemCatalog, object playerInventories, object? accountStash, uint currencyInventoryId, uint currencyItemId, uint targetInventoryId, uint targetItemId, int affixIndex, CustomCurrencyItemDefinition chargedCurrencyDef, object? statDescriptions = null, object? itemRolls = null, string? sourceCustomName = null, bool clearSourceCustomName = false, string? chargedCustomName = null, bool sendPackets = true, Func<object, object?>? shapeOf = null, Func<object, byte[], string?, Task>? sendPacket = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)` | Atomically steals an explicit affix from a Gateway item into a Charged Currency item (state-only when `player` is null or `sendPackets` is false). |
| `public Task<GatewayReplaceResult> ReplaceAffixOnGatewayItem(object? player, object itemCatalog, object playerInventories, object? accountStash, uint currencyInventoryId, uint currencyItemId, uint targetInventoryId, uint targetItemId, int replaceIndex, object? statDescriptions = null, object? itemRolls = null, string? customName = null, bool clearCustomName = false, bool sendPackets = true, Func<object, byte[], string?, Task>? sendPacket = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)` | Atomically replaces an explicit affix on a Gateway item with the affix stored in a Charged Currency item. |
| `public static Task SendInventoryDiffsAsync(object player, object playerInventories, object? accountStash, IReadOnlyList<GatewayInventoryChange> changes, string label = "server-bridge", Func<object, byte[], string?, Task>? sendPacket = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)` | Sends grouped `0x00BF` inventory/stash diff packets (and equipment refresh if worn). |

### `PoeContentHash`

**Kind:** `class` · **Namespace:** `LocalExile.Client.ServerBridge` · **Source:** `LocalExile.Client.ServerBridge/PoeContentHash.cs`

Deterministic content hashing utilities matching Path of Exile 3.29's native client and LocalExile server (`InstanceEntities.ObjectTypeHash` at `0x140df6e10`, `MtxTypes.HASH32`, `BaseItemTypes.HASH32`, and folded 16-bit dat `HASH16` keys).

```csharp
public static class PoeContentHash
```

**Methods:**

| Method | Summary |
|---|---|
| `public static uint MurmurHash2(string metadataPath)` | Computes Path of Exile 3.29's 32-bit MurmurHash2 (seed `0`) over UTF-8 encoded `metadataPath` (matching `0x14247b370` -> `0x140df6e10` and `PoeHashing.Hash32`). Returns: The 32-bit unsigned hash matching PoE 3.29's `HASH32` / `ObjectTypeHash`. |
| `public static uint MurmurHash2(ReadOnlySpan<byte> bytes)` | Computes Path of Exile 3.29's 32-bit MurmurHash2 (seed `0`) over raw `bytes`. Returns: The 32-bit unsigned MurmurHash2 digest. |
| `public static ushort FoldHash16(uint hash32)` | Folds a 32-bit PoE dat `HASH32` value into its 16-bit `HASH16` representation (`(hash32 >> 16) ^ (hash32 & 0xFFFF)`), matching stock 3.29.3d `Pet.dat` rows. Returns: Folded 16-bit hash value. |

**Kind:** `interface` · **Namespace:** `LocalExile.Client.ServerBridge` · **Source:** `LocalExile.Client.ServerBridge/ServerBridgeContracts.cs`

**Methods:**

| Method | Summary |
|---|---|
